<!-- pr-reviewer: 9ca89a5ceb7c288b19f552ca44b182bc0ee566b5 -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good:
- The gate change is the right shape: a separate non-cargo step kind (`xtask/src/site_step.rs`) that batch and release always carry and quick carries when the diff touches an input, wired into `Run::execute` in one line, with the tier rules pinned.
- The SKIP rule is honest: a missing tool is a `SKIP` row in quick and batch (never `ok`, `report_row` maps it to `SKIP`), a `FAIL` row in release, naming the tool and its install step, never silent.
- The pins are real and pass on this head (7 in `site_step_tests.rs`, plus the updated batch/release ordering tests in `tests.rs`): the input list against the paths the site tests really open, the quick-vs-batch rule, the SKIP/FAIL rule (incl. `report_row`), the dry-run lines, the note extraction, and that the step is not a cargo step and shares the lanes.
- The site fixes are resyncs, not weakenings: `panes.rs` -> `panes/cmd.rs` and `tool_library_dialog/list.rs` -> `list_header.rs` match where the labels are actually drawn (checked `label_of` and `list_header.rs`); the two rotary icons are byte-identical (md5) to `assets/ui/`; the `manualToolChange` row matches the contract in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`.
- No file in `.github/`; no workflow, trigger or runner change; no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` edit; `Process change: yes` in the body; no snapshot PNGs, no post scripts, no `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, no `build.rs`, no `.cargo/`, no dependency additions.
- Provenance comments on both new modules; conventional commit subjects; `Fixes #4133`; `Changelog: none`.

Results merged with main (trial merge of `pr-4440-review` into `origin/main`: no conflicts — the staged delta is main's own post/sim test re-foldering, not this PR):
- Worktree `cc-pr4440-review`, Linux, 24 cores, head `9ca89a5ce` (built locally — this PR touches `xtask/`, so it is not runner-able under step 2b; `xtask/` is a refusal-list file even for the runner, and this is not an xtask-only PR).
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 381 unit tests + all integration binaries green; the 7 `site_step_tests` and the updated `tests.rs` ordering tests ok.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo xtask gate batch --only "site tests"`: `SKIP ... SKIPPED (tool missing: zola, node) - not a pass; install: ...`, exit 0.
- `cargo xtask gate release --only "site tests"`: `FAIL ... tool missing: zola, node - the release tier needs it; install: ...`, exit 1.
- Site tests that need zola/node did NOT run here (neither is on this host). The tests that need no tools pass on this head: `test_first_4axis_part.py` 13/13, `test_first_continuous_4axis_part.py` 14/14, `test_post_processor_reference.py` 3/3 (incl. the new `manualToolChange` row).
- Quick plan for the PR's own diff (base `392980120`): 2 steps (`xtask unit tests`, `site tests`) — matches the author's claim and the 2 files it touches.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, release): build green (771s); `motion light: lib` green (583s, 7/7 twins ok); steps 03-06 (adaptive_troch_island/neck/parallel, app pocket_pass_start) NOT finished at review time — step 03 sat in a cold sccache compile of `camcraft-motion` for ~11 minutes on a machine shared with another light lane; the review does not count it as a pass. Non-blocking: this PR touches no heavy-lane code, and a red/incomplete light lane is a note, not a blocker (AGENTS.md "The light lane").

Targeted tests (step 5): no example catalog suites — no post or toolpath changed. Light lane: in progress at review time as above; release build green, one suite green, remaining suites not run. `P1` is `area:build` (gate tooling), not a safety-floor path — no targeted heavy step owed.

Requested before merge: none.

Questions / notes:
- The missing-tool SKIP path never attempts the site tests (prints the note and stops). On a host with python 3 but no zola/node, tool-dependent site tests would be invisible — consistent with the body, and nothing reads as a pass, but flagging the coverage.
- The input-list pin reads path literals that start with `site|assets|examples|crates|docs|scripts|xtask` plus `NAME + "..."` joins, but not concatenated paths or a top-level dir not in the regex (e.g. `data/`). A new site test reading such a path would be missed by the pin. Consider adding that case when a new top-level dir appears. Non-blocking.
- The release-tier FAIL row is deliberate (cut gate is the last check before the tag). Both runner users need python 3, zola 0.23.6 and node on PATH or the cut gate is red at the site step — the body records this for the maintainer. Follow-up #4433 (`.github` change) stays with the maintainer.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
